title: Prediction of storage time in different seafood based on color values with artificial neural network modeling.
summary: A one-hidden-layer, 30-neuron feedforward ANN uses seafood colour coordinates (L*, a*, b*) to predict storage time. The primary paper compiled 205 literature datapoints and evaluated the model on an additional 45 literature datapoints from other seafood studies; the article reports R²=0.81 for the selected topology and a predicted/observed regression coefficient of 0.85 (the abstract rounds R² to 0.80). This is a narrow food-quality prediction result, not new measurements, and the pooled literature-derived validation is not prospective field validation.
ai_technology: A feedforward MLP uses measured L*, a*, b* values as inputs and one hidden layer to output storage time; topology was chosen by comparing R² and MSE.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The selected 30-neuron topology reports R²=0.81 and MSE=0.20 during optimization; the paper separately reports a predicted/observed regression coefficient of 0.85 (abstract R² rounded to 0.80).
evidence.unknown: 205 literature experiments were split into 145/30/30 train/test/validation; a distinct additional 45 literature datapoints from other species/studies were also used as validation. The evidence is pooled retrospective data, not prospective measured validation, and species/process heterogeneity limits generalization.
